verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own docs say users can connect external agents, including coding CLIs, and set up a local Agent through a guided wizard. That is a first-party capability to embed or supervise real coding agents, and a desktop terminal and an issue-dispatch anecdote add some context. Missing for 10: documented repo workflows (cloning, editing, running tests) driven through the connected coding agent, details on which coding CLIs are supported and how they are supervised, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat

citations.quote: create agents here or connect external agents, including coding CLIs and personal agent platforms.
Connect a local Agent through one wizard.
